title: Movement
description: Arkham.Movement.Movement (backend/arkham-api/library/Arkham/Movement.hs), used by InvestigatorAttrs.investigatorMovement (Maybe Movement) to represent an in-progress move. Deep Source/Target/Cost/Message payloads stay broad and out of scope for this contract slice (see cost.schema.json); only the stable top-level keys and the closed MovementMeans/Destination tags are constrained here.

moveSource.description: Arkham.Source.Source. Broad tagged union, out of scope for this contract slice.

moveTarget.description: Arkham.Target.Target. Broad tagged union, out of scope for this contract slice.

moveAfter.description: [Arkham.Message.Message] queued to run once this movement resolves. Broad and recursive, out of scope for this contract slice.

destination.description: Arkham.Movement.Destination = ToLocation LocationId | ToLocationMatching LocationMatcher, derived with Aeson's default TaggedObject sum encoding.

contents.description: Arkham.Matcher.LocationMatcher. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

movementMeans.description: Arkham.Movement.MovementMeans = Direct | OneAtATime | Towards | Place | TowardsN Int, derived with Aeson's default TaggedObject sum encoding. Because 'TowardsN' is not nullary, 'allNullaryToStringTag' does not apply to this type: every constructor -- including the 4 nullary ones -- encodes as a TaggedObject; nullary constructors simply omit the 'contents' key (verified against the real encoder: 'Direct' encodes as {"tag":"Direct"}, not a bare string).
